name: @selis/web-host
description: Selis web deployment shell: static hosting headers (COOP/COEP/CSP) + SRI helpers and cross-origin-isolation fallback (SL-4.WEB.01), plus local-only document handoff over the WASM Worker protocol (SL-4.WEB.03). No document bytes leave the origin; no third-party scripts on the document path (ADR-P0016).
